crossrefs.text: “Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me. Then the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to His temple—the Messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight—see, He is coming,” says the LORD of Hosts.
As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way.”
People went out to him from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet: “I am a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’”
In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
Many of the sons of Israel he will turn back to the Lord their God.

And he will go on before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.”
Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
For just as rain and snow fall from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat,
so My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.

notes.title: The grass withers but the word of the Lord endures

crossrefs.text: He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majestic name of the LORD His God. And they will dwell securely, for then His greatness will extend to the ends of the earth.
For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’”
“Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the ends of the earth, “Say to Daughter Zion: See, your Savior comes! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them. He will feed them and be their shepherd.
to say to the prisoners, ‘Come out,’ and to those in darkness, ‘Show yourselves.’ They will feed along the pathways, and find pasture on every barren hill.

Who has ascended to heaven and come down? Who has gathered the wind in His hands? Who has bound up the waters in His cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is His name, and what is the name of His Son— surely you know!
And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”
In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell Me, if you have understanding.
and I declared: ‘You may come this far, but no farther; here your proud waves must stop’?
“For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to instruct Him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
To whom will you liken Me or count Me equal? To whom will you compare Me, that we should be alike?
There is no one holy like the LORD. Indeed, there is no one besides You! And there is no Rock like our God.
Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You—majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
“To whom will you liken Me, or who is My equal?” asks the Holy One.
Therefore, being offspring of God, we should not think that the Divine Being is like gold or silver or stone, an image formed by manʼs skill and imagination.
For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.
Do you have an arm like Godʼs? Can you thunder with a voice like His?
The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagleʼs.
Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
